evidence_items.explanation: The report also evaluates vision-only sensing using a cube whose center stickers were altered. This materially qualifies any implication that all results depended on embedded cube sensors; it does not establish open-ended task generalization.

OpenAI reported real transfer and robustness to unfamiliar disturbances. Those results qualify the controlled-laboratory characterization but remain narrower than dependable performance across open-ended objects and tasks.
